name: Hanamure Kukuri
source:
Class: 3-A

A girl who loves doing fun things but often seems to be in a bad mood, unless she spots something that interests her. Kukuri often skips school and wanders around downtown in search for exciting things all day and night. While her grades are decent, she is on the verge having to repeat a grade due to her constant absences.

There are rumors going around that she makes money through compensated dating...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245143]Getchu[/url]]
